brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road and into Narnia. In Chapter 10, Father Christmas brings gifts, and the Witch’s winter starts to break. Build the gifts, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read about each gift and tap who got it. Then finish two sentences about the gifts.
extra: Add an Animated Deer to pull Father Christmas’s sledge. Say what he called out as he left.
step1: These are your five models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the Canvas tab.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click Explore, type today’s map in Filter environments, and click it. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Press the top button on your right controller and click Models. Put the sword and shield together for Peter. Put the bow for Susan. Put the bottle for Lucy. Put the sewing machine for Mrs. Beaver.
step4: Point to one gift and say this out loud. The gift I would want is… because…
step5: Stand back so it all fits. Open your menu: Library, then Camera, then Take photo. Click the Canvas tab, pick this week’s VR assignment, and click Choose from My Files. Pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Then press the Meta button and click Quit.
